## Tools

Prefer crafting your own tools over depending on external ones. A script you wrote and saved is more reliable than an external API. Use the file system creatively.

### Workflow-Specific Tooling

- **The tests CLI (`node {skills-root}/eque2-code-setup/scripts/tests-cli.mjs <verb>`)** — single entry point for all test-lifecycle queries and mutations. Twelve verbs: `update`, `reset` (max 5 resets per test), `force-reset`, `summary`, `next`, `query`, `report`, `analytics`, `transitions-since`, `run-log`, `verification-reset` (admin), `verdict`. Each prints a JSON object to stdout on success or `{"error": "..."}` on failure with a non-zero exit code — check the exit code, do not retry blindly. The CLI is the sole writer of lifecycle state — state lives in signed plaintext files (`state/events.jsonl`, HMAC-signed, committed to git), not a database. Server-side verification (compliance rubric + live Playwright run) mints HMAC evidence on pass; no agent self-certifies. If the tests CLI isn't resolvable, it isn't installed — [AT]/[BK]/[US]/[RP] are limited until `/eque2-code-setup` is re-run on an upgraded module. Never fabricate lifecycle state.
- **The xray CLI (`node {skills-root}/eque2-code-setup/scripts/xray-cli.mjs <verb>`)** — the ONLY Xray access path (`sync`, `folders`, `status`, `diff`, `test`, `tests`, `steps`). Hard Rule 1: no bespoke Xray shell/Node scripts, no direct API calls from prompts, ever. Write-back (results, evidence attachment) is also a CLI verb — if the CLI isn't resolvable, [US]/[RP] stop with a clear pointer rather than improvising a script.
- **Playwright MCP** — live-UI exploration before any selector is written. Walk the journey at `BASE_URL` first; write semantic locators from what the page actually is.

### Shared Pipeline

- **`eque2-code-e2e-test` (stages 2–7)** — the canonical test-generation technique, shared with Linus's [ET]. [BT] dispatches it for one Xray test ID; [BK] fans it out across a folder with `batch_concurrency` parallel subagents. The Stage 2 Xray gate (`stepCount ≥ 1` or HARD STOP) applies unchanged in every dispatch.
- **Test-knowledge cache** — subagents write a short `.md` note per solved problem to `{output_folder}/test-knowledge/` with a `.manifest.jsonl`; [BK] injects up to `test_knowledge_max_entries` newest entries (`test_knowledge_max_kb` cap) into subagent prompts on later runs. One solved flake is never solved twice.
